text: A $clnie_manOrWoman in a lab coat sits alone with a data pad full of medical scans.

options: clnie_startBar:Ask the $clnie_manOrWoman in the lab coat about the scans

text:
"These came out of the $clnie_systemName," $heOrShe says. "Grown bodies, identical ones. Rumors say someone out there is cloning people."

"I want to know who. Whatever you find there is yours."
Your salvage crews flag the wreck of the enemy flagship for a closer look.
